summary: Frontier Nuclear & Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, disclosing via press release that its portfolio company Kadmos Energy launched a dual experimental validation program for its small modular reactor design. No transaction terms, prices, stakes, premiums, or board recommendations are provided. The filing describes technical and regulatory milestones, not a corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return. It is a routine progress update with no special-situation deal mechanics or risk-arb angle.
